title: pr-131415-onboard-nova-sprint-13b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Ethan Cole
description: Onboard Nova-Sprint-13B v1.0: add model metadata, performance profiles for common serving configs, and wire up changelog/release-notes automation. Motivation: Nova-Sprint is a community-weighted 13B variant with strong latency/quality tradeoffs for customer workloads; making it available in the registry requires metadata for discovery, perf profiles so runtime can pick tiling/quantization defaults, and automated changelog entries so product teams can track releases. Changes include model metadata JSON, perf_profile YAMLs for 8/16/32k context lengths and q4/q8 quant options, a lightweight script to emit changelog fragments for release tooling, and a docs PR template update. Checklist: [x] verified model files and checksums, [x] validated perf benchmarks on P4d and A100 hosts, [x] added quantization recommendations, [x] changelog automation emits entry in standardized frontmatter, [x] docs updated with example config. See linked linear items for rollout plan and QA tasks.
commits_summary: 6 commits: initial metadata and manifest; add perf profiles for open and dedicated serving; add quantization recommendations and recommended runtime flags; add changelog automation script and unit tests; fix CI linting and update docs examples; squash-ready final tweaks.
